`minds-launch-to-msg` can resolve a branch or tag again after the move to the private `mngr-internal` repo.

`sync_vendor` resolves the `commit_sha` input with an anonymous `git ls-remote`, which against a private repo fails with `could not read Username for 'https://github.com'`. It went unnoticed because a full 40-char SHA short-circuits before the network call, and a no-input dispatch reads `github.sha` instead -- so every dispatch since the migration took one of those paths, and the first attempt to dispatch by tag, which is exactly what the release procedure's final step does, was the first to hit it. Since every other job depends on `sync_vendor`, the run stopped there rather than skipping the sync and carrying on. The lookup is now authenticated with the workflow token.
